title: M5 reference increment 1: prove already-bound roots and expose fresh mailbox-only references
outcome: Deliver the already-bound, federation-owned reference increment independently without silently upgrading legacy proxies or claiming the full M5 association milestone.
acceptance: The bounded C-to-S POST /federation/v1/mailbox/native-binding operation uses the actual authenticated current L1/A1 channel and returns one coherent observation of an eligible native root's exact current durably installed binding, S-local native creation token, C placement/principal, full host/central identities and required freshness/correlation basis. The requested binding is only a comparison target; absent, uncertain or ineligible bindings refuse. The operation performs no installation, reservation, opt-in, runtime, mailbox or acknowledgement effect.

A fresh explicitly federation-owned configuration and typed mailbox-only reference are created from the selected verified peer's actual owned channel and confirmed native-binding proof, with non-reused handle/generation and durable local visibility only after exact response/current-basis and commit rechecks. The ordinary termal_send_to_session facade validates the current reference and sends its canonical participant id to the unchanged ordinary HTTP API. The reference is never a serving agent, native participant or executor route; legacy handles remain unchanged and unassociated, and raw-proxy/native HTTP refusal and standalone behavior remain intact.

Missing or conflicting proof/reference, wrong host or equal raw ids across hosts, native/reference recreation, stale enrollment/configuration/link/central epoch/placement, uncommitted local persistence and central outage cannot publish or use a wrong or stale reference or fall back to local mail or legacy execution. After restart/reconnect, use requires current authoritative validation; an old handle or idempotent intent is not retargeted to a successor. Two TermAl instances on one SSH machine do not establish continuity. Missing native binding visibly refuses; no M4 installation effect or journal is introduced.

Deterministic tests exercise the production proof producer, durable reference provision/resolve path, actual MCP facade and ordinary HTTP, including canonical/reference equivalence without duplicate participants or mailboxes, old-handle and executor-fallback refusal, current/stale/recreated/missing binding cases, persistence failure/reload and outage/recovery. Pre-existing native binding and readiness fixture setup are disclosed; no fixture-injected successful association or proof counts as positive evidence. Coverage maps only to the named partial C1/C3/C4 clauses of the parent and proves neither missing native provisioning, live O1/Mac readiness nor full M5 completion.

Focused tests and the full five-stage gate pass on the exact input, and the independent read-only different-vendor review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding. Evidence pins the accepted M2/O1/L1/security dependencies, source and test fingerprints, and actual proof/reference path; no run starts before the coordinator releases both-landed exact carried input. Independent acceptance and completion apply only to this child, not the parent's remaining scope.
